ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (12) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The title «Для чего люди одурманиваются?» (Dlya chego lyudi odurmanivayutsya?, 'For what do people stupefy themselves?') keeps the established English title 'Why Do Men Stupefy Themselves?'; in the body «люди» (lyudi) is 'people'. The image of the two beings is kept literal: «зрячее» (zryacheye, 'sighted') against «слепое» (slepoye, 'blind'), and «указания совести» (ukazaniya sovesti) is consistently 'the indications of conscience'; «засорить глаза» (zasorit' glaza) is 'foul the eyes'.
